w: One of the mightiest strongholds of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, built from 1579 by Chancellor Jan Zamoyski, this fortress withstood six sieges by Cossacks, Swedes and Russians alike. Its longest ordeal, in 1813, held out eight months before the fortress finally fell obsolete and was pulled down in 1866.
